name: Sword of Wounding
description: A longsword with a serrated edge that leaves cuts that will not close.
body:
## What it does

Any sword can carry this curse on its victims; this one is a longsword. Hit points it takes come back only with rest, never by magic. Once a turn, when you hit with it, you can leave a wound that bleeds at the start of each of the creature's turns, one more for every wound it carries. It makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at each of those times, and a success closes every wound it has. A DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check closes them too.

damage.note: at the start of each of the target's turns for every wound it carries, until a DC 15 Constitution save closes them

features.name: Wounding
features.text: Hit points lost to it return only with a rest. Once per turn, a hit can leave a wound.
